sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: When you submit a booking request or contact form, we collect your name, phone number, email address, travel dates, route details, and any additional notes you provide. We also collect standard web analytics data such as page views and referrer URLs.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information to respond to your inquiries, confirm bookings, arrange vehicle and driver logistics, send trip-related updates, and improve our website and services. We do not sell or rent personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.content: Your personal information may be shared with our drivers solely for the purpose of fulfilling your booking. We may also use trusted third-party services for website hosting and analytics, which process data on our behalf under strict confidentiality agreements.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.content: We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.content: This website uses cookies and analytics tools to understand how visitors interact with our pages. This helps us improve content and user experience. You may disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data held by us. To exercise these rights, please contact us at the email address listed on our Contact page.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised date. Continued use of the website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: Booking & Confirmation
sections.content: All bookings are subject to vehicle availability and confirmation by our team. A booking request submitted through the website or WhatsApp does not constitute a confirmed reservation until you receive written confirmation from Traveling Bangladesh Rent A Car.

sections.heading: Pricing & Payment
sections.content: Prices displayed on the website are starting rates and may vary based on route, duration, fuel type, and season. Final pricing will be confirmed before your trip. Payment is collected at the start of the trip unless otherwise agreed in writing.

sections.heading: Cancellation Policy
sections.content: Cancellations made at least 48 hours before the scheduled pickup are eligible for a full refund of any advance payment. Cancellations within 48 hours may incur a cancellation fee of up to 25% of the booking value. No-shows are non-refundable.

sections.heading: Driver Conduct
sections.content: All drivers are professionally trained, verified, and bound by our code of conduct. They follow traffic regulations, maintain confidentiality of passenger information, and prioritize safety at all times.

sections.heading: Vehicle Condition
sections.content: Every vehicle undergoes a thorough inspection before each trip. Vehicles are clean, mechanically sound, and equipped with air conditioning. If you experience any issue during your trip, please contact our support team immediately.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.content: Traveling Bangladesh Rent A Car is responsible for providing the vehicle and driver as confirmed in your booking. We are not liable for delays caused by traffic, weather, road closures, or other circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh. Any disputes arising from bookings or use of our services shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know before booking your ride with us.

items.question: How do I book a car?
items.answer: Simply use the request a quote form on our home or contact page, or message us on WhatsApp. Share your pickup and drop-off location, travel date, and preferred vehicle, and our team will confirm availability within minutes.

items.question: Do you provide a driver with the rental?
items.answer: Yes. Every rental includes a professional, verified driver who knows the roads of Bangladesh. This keeps your journey safe, relaxed, and completely stress-free.

items.question: Are prices per day or for the whole trip?
items.answer: Prices shown are starting daily rates. The final fare depends on your route, distance, duration, and vehicle type. We always agree on a clear, fixed price with you before the trip begins — no hidden charges.

items.question: Which areas of Bangladesh do you cover?
items.answer: We cover the entire country — from Dhaka and Chittagong to Sylhet, Cox's Bazar, Sundarbans, and beyond. If you can drive there, we can take you there.

items.question: Can I book for a wedding, corporate, or special event?
items.answer: Absolutely. We arrange vehicles for weddings, corporate transport, group tours, school trips, and VIP transfers. Tell us the details and we will put together the right fleet for your event.

items.question: How can I pay?
items.answer: We accept cash, bKash, and bank transfer. Payment is collected at the start of your trip unless otherwise agreed in writing. You only pay the exact amount we confirmed — no surprises.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Cancellations made at least 48 hours before pickup receive a full refund of any advance payment. Cancellations within 48 hours may incur a fee of up to 25% of the booking value.
